steps.what: Recirculation pump started; level about 30 percent; temperature 60-65 C; pressure 22 psig

checks.id: Temperature after the pump started, before heating (18:16 to 18:38, mean)
checks.says: p. 38: pump started 6:14 p.m.; temperature between 60 and 65 C

checks.note: The figure's own pressure trace sits about 3 psig above the text's 22 psig for the whole steady period, about 22 pixels, far outside the pixel error. The pressure scale itself is confirmed by the two labelled pressures (44 psig at the relief, 51.2 psig at failure), which both pass. The figure and the text disagree; the replay uses the figure and states the difference.

checks.says: The outside operator started the recirculation pump at 6:14 p.m. (p. 38)
checks.stated: IL-3 stops being 'met' (no flow) within 2 minutes of 18:14

steps.what: Temperature begins rising about 0.6 C per minute
Level 51 percent; recirculation flow drops to zero

checks.says: p. 39: flow dropped to zero at 10:21 p.m.
p. 39: 141 C in less than 3 minutes
checks.note: The trace reaches 141 °C at about 22:27, not before 22:24. The report says the control system measured both the bulk liquid and the recirculation loop (p. 28); the text may quote the other sensor. Not verified: the report does not say which temperature the figure plots.

checks.says: At 10:21 p.m. ... the recirculation flow suddenly dropped to zero. (p. 39)
checks.stated: IL-3 becomes 'met' (no flow) within 2 minutes of 22:21

checks.says: The temperature was at 141 C, rapidly approaching 155 C, the safe operating limit. (p. 39)
checks.stated: T-SOL (155 C) is never reached before the failure

steps.what: High pressure alarm at the work station (approximately)

checks.says: At approximately 10:25 p.m., the residue treater high pressure alarm sounded ... the pressure was above the maximum operating pressure. (p. 40)
checks.stated: IL-2 stops being 'clear' before 22:25 (the pressure has left its normal level by the alarm)

checks.id: Pressure when the relief valve opened

checks.stated: PT-101 stops rising within 1.5 minutes of 22:27 (its first local maximum after 22:20)

checks.id: Failure line position (the figure's dotted line)

checks.note: The trace reaches the failure line about 1.6 °C below the figure's own 150.3 °C label, about 4.5 pixels. The trace was rising about 1 °C per 30-second column there, so the label may be a later reading than the last drawn point, which the dotted failure line partly covers.
